description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made to Charge and Levy Ports and Airports Development Levy on import of Petroleum Oils etc, to exempt the Payment of Levy on Live bovine animals, Waters Vehicles, etc and to declare the import of medical equipment for donations, etc, as exempt articles w.e.f. 01.01.2016
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the issuance of a legal order under the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011. It establishes regulatory changes to levy rates, exemptions, and import regulations. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to make regulatory changes, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The content focuses entirely on legal/regulatory framework modifications rather than government structure or personnel matters.
